title: Câu Hỏi Đuôi – Luyện Tập

exercises.explanation: This is... -> This -> đổi thành 'it' ở đuôi -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: isn't it.

exercises.question: Nobody was late for the meeting last night??
exercises.explanation: Nobody was late... -> Nobody (phủ định) -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định số nhiều: were they.

exercises.question: I think he will join us??
exercises.explanation: I think he will join us -> Mệnh đề chính có 'I think' -> câu hỏi đuôi theo mệnh đề phụ 'he will join us' -> won't he.

exercises.question: Ba didn’t produce the first TV picture in 1920??
exercises.explanation: Ba didn't produce... -> Phủ định quá khứ đơn -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: did he.

exercises.question: Let’s listen to the radio??
exercises.explanation: Let's listen... -> Let's -> câu hỏi đuôi mặc định: shall we.

exercises.question: Please, turn off the TV??
exercises.explanation: Please, turn off... (Câu mệnh lệnh/yêu cầu lịch sự) -> câu hỏi đuôi: will you.

exercises.question: Jane, you haven't got a pen??
exercises.explanation: Jane, you haven't got... -> Phủ định hiện tại hoàn thành 'haven't' -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: have you.

exercises.question: She has a lovely voice??
exercises.explanation: She has... -> 'has' ở đây là động từ thường chỉ sở hữu -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định hiện tại đơn: doesn't she.

exercises.question: Kate, you don't know where Ann is??
exercises.explanation: Kate, you don't know... -> Phủ định 'don't' -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: do you.

exercises.question: There are many interesting programs tonight??
exercises.explanation: There are... -> Câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: aren't there.

exercises.question: I am late for the party??
exercises.explanation: I am late... -> 'I am' ở câu khẳng định -> câu hỏi đuôi mặc định: aren't I.

exercises.question: No one can help you??
exercises.explanation: No one can... -> No one (phủ định) -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định 'can they'.

exercises.question: You must give up smoking??
exercises.explanation: You must give up... -> Must chỉ sự khuyên bảo, cần thiết -> câu hỏi đuôi dùng: needn't you.

exercises.question: I didn’t do anything wrong??
exercises.explanation: I didn't do... -> Phủ định quá khứ đơn 'didn't do' -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: did I.

exercises.question: You suppose that Gillian will marry him??
exercises.explanation: You suppose that Gillian will marry him -> Mệnh đề chính bắt đầu bằng 'You suppose' (không phải I think/suppose) -> câu hỏi đuôi vẫn lấy theo mệnh đề chính 'You suppose' -> don't you.

exercises.question: I suppose that all the tickets will be sold tomorrow??
exercises.explanation: I suppose that all the tickets will be sold... -> Mệnh đề chính 'I suppose' -> câu hỏi đuôi theo mệnh đề phụ 'all the tickets will be sold' -> won't they.

exercises.question: You may see me tomorrow??
exercises.explanation: You may see... -> Động từ khuyết thiếu 'may' -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: mayn't you.

exercises.question: What an amazing performance??
exercises.explanation: What an amazing performance -> Câu cảm thán -> lấy chủ ngữ 'it' và tobe phủ định -> isn't it.

exercises.question: It seems that you're going to be late again??
exercises.explanation: It seems that you're going to be late again -> 'It seems that' -> câu hỏi đuôi chia theo mệnh đề phụ 'you're going...' -> aren't you.

exercises.question: There were a lot of people at the concert??
exercises.explanation: There were... -> Khẳng định 'There were' -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: weren't there.

exercises.question: I’m going to be with you tomorrow night??
exercises.explanation: I'm going to be... -> 'I am' khẳng định -> câu hỏi đuôi mặc định: aren't I.

exercises.question: You had a good time at the game??
exercises.explanation: You had a good time... -> 'had' là động từ thường chỉ hành động ở quá khứ đơn -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: didn't you.

exercises.question: They’ve never had a child??
exercises.explanation: They've never had... -> Never (phủ định) -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định hiện tại hoàn thành: have they.

exercises.question: Mary hardly ever cooks??
exercises.explanation: Mary hardly ever cooks -> Hardly ever (bán phủ định) -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: does she.

exercises.question: Neither of them offered to help you??
exercises.explanation: Neither of them offered... -> Neither (phủ định), quá khứ đơn 'offered' -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: did they.

exercises.question: He ought to have made a note of it??
exercises.explanation: He ought to... -> Ought to -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: oughtn't he.

exercises.question: Nobody liked the play??
exercises.explanation: Nobody liked... -> Nobody (phủ định), quá khứ đơn 'liked' -> câu hỏi đuôi khẳng định: did they.

exercises.question: Bill put the money in the bank??
exercises.explanation: Bill put... -> 'put' ở đây là quá khứ đơn (vì chủ ngữ Bill số ít, nếu hiện tại phải là puts) -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: didn't he.

exercises.question: This will fit in your pocket??
exercises.explanation: This will fit... -> This -> đổi thành 'it' ở đuôi -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: won't it.

exercises.question: He used to eat raw fish??
exercises.explanation: He used to... -> Used to -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: didn't he.

exercises.question: You'd better wait for Bill??
exercises.explanation: You'd better... -> Had better -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định mượn trợ động từ 'had': hadn't you.

exercises.question: You'd come if I needed help??
exercises.explanation: You'd come if I needed help -> You'd là viết tắt của 'You would' -> câu hỏi đuôi phủ định: wouldn't you.
